findings.description: The lint script ignores project.env's 'an empty value turns off the check' contract, which the hook honours (exits 0 when either key is empty). An empty FILE_NAMING_SCOPE_REGEX matches every path, so README.md and package.json fail. An empty FILE_NAMING_REGEX still leaves the folder check running. A removed key aborts under set -u. Add `[ -n "${FILE_NAMING_SCOPE_REGEX:-}" ] && [ -n "${FILE_NAMING_REGEX:-}" ] || exit 0` after load_project_env.

The comment above the naming block still says 'the 25 roles of docs/conventions/naming.md' and scopes to src/ only. Dropping integration.test leaves 24 roles in FILE_NAMING_REGEX/FILE_NAMING_HINT (the README now says 24), and the scope is now src|test.

Removing integration.test from FILE_NAMING_REGEX means a new foo.integration.test.ts is now blocked. docs/conventions/naming.md:69 still lists that role, and AGENTS.md's Testing area (and .claude/rules/testing-conventions.md) still globs **/*.integration.test.ts. Either keep the role or drop it from the docs in the same change.

A path containing a newline is matched against the allowlist as several patterns (grep -qxF treats \n as a separator), so a misnamed file under a directory named e.g. `src/core/merge-gate.errors.ts\nx/` matches an allowlist entry and passes lint. Reject paths containing a newline before the grep.

The repo has no top-level test/ directory: tests live under src/, and vitest.config.ts includes only src/**/*.test.ts. So the new `test/` scope alternative is dead, and the mock=helpers rule and 'test mocks in test/helpers/' hint point at a folder that doesn't exist (the existing mock is src/test/temp-dir.mock.ts).

The role-to-folder logic (role derivation, the FILE_NAMING_ROLE_DIRS loop, the parent-dir compare) is written out separately in the hook and in the lint script, so the two can drift even though both claim to apply 'the same two checks'. A shared helper in hooks/lib/project-env.sh, which both already source, would hold it once.

The block message hardcodes the layout ('src/<area>/{types,enums,errors,interfaces,constants}/, test mocks in test/helpers/'), which repeats FILE_NAMING_ROLE_DIRS. Editing the config would leave this text stale. Build the text from the map or move it into the config.
`[ -f "$ALLOW" ] || : > "$ALLOW"` makes the lint command create the committed allowlist as a side effect, so a deleted allowlist silently becomes an empty one. Dropping the line is simpler.

The validate-file-naming.sh table row now packs the full lint-script and allowlist explanation into one cell, and that text is already in check-file-layout.sh's header. Consider trimming the row to a pointer.

refuted_findings.description: Nothing the repo automates runs `pnpm lint`, so the new layout check and its allowlist must-shrink invariant only fire when someone runs `pnpm lint` by hand; the Stop hook and pre-commit run the biome-only LINT_CMD and CI has no lint step.
refuted_findings.refutation: pup's merge gate runs it. src/adapters/typescript.adapter.ts:47 sets GATE_STAGES = ['build','test','lint'], and lines 254-256 emit `<pm> run <stage>` for every stage that package.json defines. packageManager() resolves to pnpm, so src/core/merge-gate.service.ts (gateCommands/commandFor, ~L1892) runs `pnpm run lint`, which is biome followed by scripts/check-file-layout.sh. The Stop hook and pre-commit don't run it, but the gate does, so 'nothing automated runs it' is false.

process_issues.description: The reviewer briefs gave the PR's restored config copies as `.claude-pr/<path relative to .claude/>`, but the real layout is `.claude-pr/.claude/<path>`. Correctness and security found it. Context and docs did not, and fell back to the base-branch copies plus `gh pr diff`. The diff covers every changed line, so their coverage held.
